description: This file defines models, enums, constants, and default settings for a slider widget in a dashboard application, including layout options, styling, and RPC configurations.

methods.name: SliderLayout
methods.description: Enumeration of possible slider layout options.

methods.name: sliderLayouts
methods.description: Array of all slider layout keys.

methods.name: sliderLayoutTranslations
methods.description: Map linking slider layouts to translation keys.

methods.name: sliderLayoutImages
methods.description: Map linking slider layouts to their respective image asset paths.

methods.name: SliderWidgetSettings
methods.description: Interface defining the configuration options for the slider widget.

methods.name: sliderWidgetDefaultSettings
methods.description: Default configuration object for the slider widget.
